System 05 / Multi-level picking

Multi-Tier Shelving

Multi-tier shelving is a shelving structure built on two to four levels, with walkways, stairs and safety gates between them, so that staff can hand-pick small items from the full height of the building. ProRack designs and manufactures multi-tier shelving in Hyderabad.

How it works

How multi-tier shelving works

The shelving uprights carry the walkways of the upper levels, so one structure provides both storage and access floors. Pickers walk the aisles on each level and send goods down through chutes or lifts.

Stairs, gates, handrails and toe boards are designed in from the start, and sprinkler integration is coordinated with the fire design for the building.

Is it the right fit?

When to choose multi-tier shelving

  • You pick small items or cartons by hand
  • You have many SKUs with low quantities each
  • The building has height you are not using
  • You want storage and access in one structure

Compare

When another system may fit better

  • Mezzanine floors when you need an open floor for offices, assembly or packing.
  • Carton flow racking for fast FIFO picking faces.
  • Selective pallet racking for full pallets.

Planning a project

What we need for a quotation

  • Project location and expected timeline
  • Warehouse dimensions, clear height and column grid
  • Pallet or item dimensions and weights
  • Number of storage positions required
  • Handling equipment in use or planned
  • Floor slab details, if available

ProRack reviews the requirement, prepares a layout and structural design in Tekla Structures and RSTAB, manufactures in Hyderabad and installs through SmartFit Solutions. See how we engineer projects.

Questions

Multi-Tier Shelving FAQs

What is the difference between multi-tier shelving and a mezzanine floor?

In multi-tier shelving the shelving itself supports the upper walkways, so the structure is designed around picking aisles. A mezzanine floor is an independent structural floor that creates open space which can be used for storage, offices or assembly.

How many levels can multi-tier shelving have?

ProRack multi-tier shelving is typically built with 2 to 4 picking levels. The number of levels depends on the building height, loads, access and fire safety requirements.

How is fire safety handled in multi-tier shelving?

Walkway decking, handrails, toe boards and stairs are designed in, and sprinkler integration is coordinated with the building fire design. Local fire regulations should be confirmed early in the project.
